verses.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.sm: O le amio leaga a le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio ) Ona fetalai atu ai lea o Iesu i lè motu O tagata ma ona soo,

verses.en: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
verses.sm: “Ua tietie le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio i le nofoa o Mose;

verses.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.sm: O lea ia outou anaana ai ma ia outou faia mea uma latou te fai atu ai ia te outou e anaana i ai; a e aua tou te faaaʻoaʻo i a latou amio; aua ua latou fai atu, a e latou te le faia.

verses.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.sm: Auà ua latou saisai avega mamafa rna le avegata, ma latou faaee i ua o tagata; a e latou te le mafafai ina faagaoioi ai i so latou tamatamai lima.

verses.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.sm: Ua latou fai a latou galuega uma, ina ia iloa ai e tagata; ua latou faalautele i a latou filateri, ma faatele i tuupao o latou ofu.

verses.en: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.sm: Ua latou fiafia foi i le mea sili e taoto ai i faigaai, ma nofoa sili i sunako,

verses.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.sm: ma ia alofaina i latou i malae, ia taʻua foi i latou e tagata, Rapi e.

verses.en: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.sm: A o outou, aua ne“ taʻua outou o rapi; aua e toatasi la outou a'oa'o; a o outou uma o le au uso outou.

verses.en: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.sm: Aua foi neʻi tou taʻua se tasi i le lalolagi o lo outou tamà; auā e toatasi lo outou Tama, o i le lagi la.

verses.en: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.sm: Aua foi ne“ taʻua outou o aʻoaʻo; aua e toatasi la outou a'oa'o, o le Keriso lea.

verses.en: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.sm: A o lé sili ia te outou e fai lea ma a outou auauna.

verses.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.sm: O sé faamaualuga o ia la te ia, e faamaulaloina lea; a o sé faamaulalo o ia ia te la, e faamaualugaina lea.

verses.en: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.sm: “Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! Aua ua outou pupuni le malo o le lagi i tagata;

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.sm: aua tou te le ulu atu i ai outou, ua outou vavao foi i e a ulu atu i ai.!

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! aua ua soo le sami ma le laueleele ia te outou ina ia lotu mai o se tasi; pe a maua foi o ia, ona outou faia lea o ia ma tagata o Kéna ua sili ona leaga ia te outou.

verses.en: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.sm: “Oi talofa ia te outou ta°ita‘i tauaso! O e fai mai, Ai sé tauto i le malumalu, ua leai lea; a o sé tauto i le auro o le malumalu, ua mau lea.

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.sm: Tagata valea e ma le tauaso; aua o le fea ua sili, o le auro ea, po o le malumalu ua paia ai le auro?

verses.en: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.sm: I le ma lea, Ai sé tauto i le fata faitaulaga, ua leai lea; a o sé tauto i le taulaga ua i ona luga, ua mau lea.

verses.en: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.sm: Tagata valea e ma le tauaso; aua o le fea ua sili, o le taulaga ea, po o le fata faitaulaga ua paia ai le taulaga?

verses.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.sm: O lenei, o lē tauto i le fata faitaulaga, ua ia tauto i ai, ma mea uma ua i ona luga;

verses.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.sm: o lé tauto foi i le malumalu, ua ia tauto i ai, ma lé o afio ai.

verses.en: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.sm: O le Ua ta4a i nisi ata o lenei tusi i le gagana Elcni o le f. e 14, Oi ralofa ia te outou tumupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! auā ua outou faauma fale o fufine ua on a latou tane, ua faalevaleva foi a owon tatalo є fai ma uўup; o le tea lea c atili ai lava ona faasalaina outou. tauto foi i le lagi, ua ia tauto i le nofoalii o le Atua, ma lé o tietie ai.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.sm: “Oi talofa ¡a te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! Ua outou avatu mea e sefulu ai o le mili, ma le aneto, ma le kumina, a ua tuu e outou o mea silisili o i le tulafono, o le amiotonu, ma le alofa, ma le faamaoni; e tatau pe ana faia nei mea, a e aua foi le tuu na mea.

verses.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.sm: O outou tafita‘i tauaso, ua outou faapilia le namu, a ua outou folo atoa le kamela.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! Ua outou faamamá i le tua o le ipu ma le tanoa, a o totonu ua tutumu i mea ua faoa ma le amio leaga.

verses.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.sm: O oe na le faresaio tauaso, ia e muai faamama i totonu o le ipu ma le tanoa, ina ia mama atoa ma le tua.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.sm: Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! Auà e tutusa outou ma tuugamau ua faasinasinaina, o loo matagofie i fafo, a o totonu ua tutumu i ivi o tagata oti, ma mea leaga uma.

verses.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.sm: E faapea foi outou, o fafo ua mataamiotonu i luma o tagata, a o totonu, ua tutumu outou i le pepelo ma le amioletonu.

verses.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.sm: “Oi talofa ia te outou tusiupu ma faresaio, tagata faafiaamiotonu! Auā ua outou ati ae tuugamau o perofeta, ua outou teuteu foi loa o tagata amiotonu,

verses.en: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.sm: ma outou faapea ane, Ana matou i ai i ia ona po o matou tama, po ua matou le “au faatasi ma i latou i le fāsiga o perofeta.

verses.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.sm: O lea, ua molia ai outou E outou, o fanau outou a e na fasiotia perofeta.

verses.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.sm: O outou foi, ia outou faatumuina le fua a o outou tama.

verses.en: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.sm: O outou gata, o fanau a gata feai, pe faapefea ona outou sosola i le faasala i Kéna?

verses.en: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.sm: Faauta mai, o le mea lea ou te aauina atu ai ia te outou o perofeta, ma tagata popoto, ma tusiupu; o isi o i latou tou te fāsiotia ma faasatauroina; a o isi, tou te sasaina i o outou sunako, ma tulituliloa ia te i latou i lea aai ma lea aai;

verses.en: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.sm: ina ia oo ia te outou le toto uma o e amiotonu ua faamaligiina i le lalolagi, e afua i le toto o Apelu le tagata amiotonu, E oo i le toto o Sakaria le atalii o Parakaio, na outou fasiotia i le va o le malumalu ma le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e oo mai nei mea uma i luga o lenei tupulaga.

verses.en: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.sm: “Ierusalema e, Ierusalema e, o lē fasiotia perofeta, ma fetogi i maa i e ua aauina atu ia te oe; ua tele lava oʻu manao e faapotopoto i lau fanau, e pei o łe moa ona ofaofatai i lana toloai i lalo i ona apaau a e lei mafafai outou.

verses.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua tuua lo outou fale, e faatafunaina.

verses.en: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.sm: Auā ou te fai atu ia te outou, tou te le toe iloa mai aʻu, seia outou fai mai, Ia manuia lē maliu mai i le suafa o le
